description: This file defines an Angular service class 'DeviceService' that provides methods for managing devices via HTTP API calls, including CRUD operations, device credential management, RPC commands, device claiming/unclaiming, and device-related resource downloads within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DeviceService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service class for device management operations in Thingsboard.

methods.name: getDeviceInfosByQuery
methods.description: Fetches device info data based on a query.

methods.name: getTenantDeviceInfos
methods.description: Retrieves device info data for a tenant with pagination and optional type filtering.

methods.name: getTenantDeviceInfosByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves tenant device info data filtered by device profile ID.

methods.name: getCustomerDeviceInfos
methods.description: Retrieves device info data for a specific customer with pagination and optional type filtering.

methods.name: getCustomerDeviceInfosByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves customer device info data filtered by device profile ID.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Fetches a device by its ID.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Fetches multiple devices by their IDs.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific device.

methods.name: saveDevice
methods.description: Creates or updates a device, with optional save parameters.

methods.name: saveDeviceWithCredentials
methods.description: Creates or updates a device along with its credentials.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device by its ID.

methods.name: getDeviceTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available device subtypes.

methods.name: getDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves device credentials, optionally synchronously.

methods.name: saveDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Saves device credentials.

methods.name: makeDevicePublic
methods.description: Makes a device publicly accessible.

methods.name: assignDeviceToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a device to a customer.

methods.name: unassignDeviceFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes device from a customer.

methods.name: sendOneWayRpcCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way RPC command to a device.

methods.name: sendTwoWayRpcCommand
methods.description: Sends a two-way RPC command to a device.

methods.name: getPersistedRpc
methods.description: Retrieves a persisted RPC by ID.

methods.name: deletePersistedRpc
methods.description: Deletes a persisted RPC.

methods.name: getPersistedRpcRequests
methods.description: Retrieves RPC requests for a device with pagination and status filtering.

methods.name: findByQuery
methods.description: Finds devices based on a search query.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a device by its name.

methods.name: claimDevice
methods.description: Claims a device for a customer.

methods.name: unclaimDevice
methods.description: Unclaims a device from a customer.

methods.name: assignDeviceToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a device to an edge.

methods.name: unassignDeviceFromEdge
methods.description: Removes a device from an edge.

methods.name: getEdgeDevices
methods.description: Retrieves devices associated with an edge.

methods.name: bulkImportDevices
methods.description: Imports multiple devices in bulk.

methods.name: getDevicePublishTelemetryCommands
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry commands for a device.

methods.name: downloadGatewayDockerComposeFile
methods.description: Downloads Docker Compose file for device gateway.

methods.name: rebootDevice
methods.description: Reboots a device, optionally as bootstrap server, with RPC commands.

methods.name: rebootTrigger
methods.description: Triggers a reboot via RPC command.
